title: LuckRead Neon Schema Migration Ledger Contract
scope: Shared append-only schema migration provenance ledger installed independently inside each approved Neon database.

checksum.artifactBundleEncoding: UTF-8 path-framed binary stream: for artifact paths sorted by ordinal byte order, append uint32-be path-byte-length, UTF-8 relative path bytes, uint64-be content-byte-length, then raw file bytes.
checksum.manifestEntryEncoding: SHA-256 over canonical JSON with recursively ordinal-sorted object keys and array order preserved.
checksum.artifactDrift: Fail closed when an already-applied migration id has a different artifact checksum or manifest-entry checksum.
checksum.sourceCommit: Record the exact 40-character Git commit SHA whose migration artifacts were executed.

lock.scope: One serial migration executor per database.

execution.existingRecord: Skip only when migration id, owner, order, kind, artifact checksum and manifest-entry checksum all match exactly.
execution.checksumMismatch: Stop immediately; never overwrite, delete or repair ledger rows automatically.
execution.sqlAtomicity: Each PostgreSQL SQL migration and its ledger insert must share one transaction.
execution.payloadAtomicity: W01 must use the official Payload native migration runner; reconcile its payload_migrations record and resulting catalog before appending the shared ledger row after the Payload transaction commits.
execution.failure: A failed SQL migration rolls back its DDL and ledger insert together. Do not write a successful ledger row for failed work.
execution.recovery: Interrupted/non-atomic Payload application requires read-only catalog and Payload migration-ledger reconciliation before retry; no blind replay.
execution.targetGuard: Validate TLS, current_database(), D1 domain/database mapping, PostgreSQL major version, schema emptiness/expected prior ledger state and exact manifest before any DDL.
